reason: Both are US building-products manufacturers selling through distributors to contractors, and both serve commercial buildings. CSW's main lines are HVAC/R and plumbing accessories, architectural products such as railing, smoke-rated and fire-rated opening protection, and firestopping. It also makes industrial lubricants. Carlisle focuses on roofing membranes, insulation and weatherproofing. The product overlap is limited to the broad building-envelope and code-compliant building-components area, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
